body:
### Summary

When I try to install a specific package from a private repository in GCP’s Artifact Registry using `uv add`, I get an HTTP status client error (403 Forbidden) and the installation fails.

Since I can install other packages from the private repo, such as `numpy`, I don’t think this is an authentication issue. In my case, I am unable to install `xlwings` as shown below.

`uv add xlwings`
error: Failed to fetch:
       `https://asia-northeast1-python.pkg.dev/{project}/{repo}/xlwings/xlwings-0.36.10-cp313-cp313-macosx_10_12_x86_64.whl`
  Caused by: HTTP status client error (403 Forbidden) for url
             (https://asia-northeast1-python.pkg.dev/artifacts-downloads/namespaces/{project}/repositories/{repo}/downloads/***)

### Platform

Windows

### Version

0.11.32 (3010295ae 2026-07-23 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)

### Python version

Python 3.13.5
title: uv add from GCP artifact registry returning HTTP status client error (403 Forbidden)
